matchups.preview: This week's slate includes Supernova Takeover vs. packerlove24. Supernova Takeover and packerlove24 have met 3 times in the regular season, with Supernova Takeover averaging 139.73 points to packerlove24's 155.94. Bob (Lambeau Leapers/packerlove24) is the father of both Mark (Supernovas) and Mikey G (Supernova Takeover/phillyphilly06), who are brothers. Supernova Takeover projects for a real edge at RB this week -- about 4.9 points clear of packerlove24 there. If you want offense, check the archives: 2025 Week 6 saw this pair put up 339.36 points between them.

This week's slate includes Chig-a-Doodle-Doo vs. VRDNO. This is only the second-ever meeting between Chig-a-Doodle-Doo and VRDNO; VRDNO took the first. The numbers favor VRDNO at TE by about 13.7 points this week -- worth a lineup check if you're Chig-a-Doodle-Doo. Their highest-scoring meeting ever came in 2025 Week 11, when they combined for 295.58 points.

Tanner Time is the sentimental pick against Newman’s Owen this week, because the numbers (74-26) sure aren't. Tanner Time and Newman’s Owen have met 15 times in the regular season, with Tanner Time averaging 134.48 points to Newman’s Owen's 114.47. The numbers favor Tanner Time at RB by about 3.5 points this week -- worth a lineup check if you're Newman’s Owen. Their highest-scoring meeting ever came in 2024 Week 16, when they combined for 329.22 points.

Big Dumb Sports and Supernovas face off this week. Supernovas holds a 8-3 career edge over Big Dumb Sports in the regular season -- not exactly a rivalry at this point. Pat, Jamie, Nick, Mark, Anthony (Acap), Kodi, Dennis, and TJ all attended Delsea together for high school. Their highest-scoring meeting ever came in 2022 Week 2, when they combined for 333.8 points. The numbers favor Big Dumb Sports at RB by about 5.0 points this week -- worth a lineup check if you're Supernovas.

This week's slate includes theMadgician vs. Jake From State Farm. theMadgician and Jake From State Farm have only played once before -- Jake From State Farm won it. Around the league, Jake From State Farm goes by the insurance company. Their highest-scoring meeting ever came in 2025 Week 1, when they combined for 247.24 points.

Bandits and ROK Navy's Finest is as close to a coin flip as the power scores get this week. This is only the second-ever meeting between Bandits and ROK Navy's Finest; Bandits took the first. Back in 2025 Week 6, these two combined for 265.86 points -- still their high-water mark against each other. You might know Bandits better as the thieves.
